description: Accept a seller's quoted price and charge it with the same payment options as confirm_purchase. Requires buyer purchase access. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

quote_id.description: Quote id from list_my_quotes or get_quote_status.
